default_action.description: The default action to be taken when traffic matches this DNS security category.

description.description: A description or explanation of what this category represents. Maximum length of 256 characters.

id.description: The unique system identifier for this specific DNS Security Category resource. This is the primary key for the resource.

log_level.description: Specifies the severity or detail level at which events related to this category are logged.

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for this DNS Security Category. Required field. Maximum length of 128 characters.

tags.description: A information field that can be added to identify the user. Maximum 10 unique tags of length 1024 each are allowed.

threat_category_id.description: The unique identifier linking this DNS category to a broader Threat Category grouping. Used for classifying the type of threat (e.g., malware, phishing) associated with the DNS category.
